| | | **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE**
APRIL 28, 2022
---
**CONTACT
[PRESS@DAVIDPERDUEGA.COM](mailto:press@davidperduega.com)**
---
| **_STATEMENT ON PERDUE’S GRAY TV DEBATE VICTORY_**
---
| **SAVANNAH, GA** – Perdue Spokeswoman Jenni Sweat released the following statement on David Perdue’s victory in tonight’s Gray Television debate:

“David Perdue had another decisive win tonight and clearly has Brian Kemp on his heels. Perdue continued to expose Kemp as a weak Governor who keeps his ‘powder dry’ instead of making tough decisions. Kemp has divided the party, and if he’s our nominee, Stacey Abrams will be Georgia’s next Governor. David Perdue is proud to be endorsed by President Trump, and as Governor, he will secure our elections, eliminate the state income tax, crush crime, and stop the indoctrination of our kids. We are fired up and excited to keep building on this strong momentum.”
---
| ###
---
| _**Trump-endorsed David Perdue**_ launched his campaign for Governor of Georgia on Dec. 6th, 2021. As an outsider, Perdue’s bold, conservative vision includes fighting for election integrity, eliminating the state income tax, empowering parents to make decisions in their children’s education, and making our cities and state safe again. Perdue is taking on incumbent Brian Kemp as the only candidate who can unite Georgia’s fractured Republican Party and defeat Stacey Abrams in November. Perdue grew up in Middle Georgia, the son of two public school teachers, and paid his way through Georgia Tech by working warehouse and construction jobs. He has over 40 years of business experience, leading the Reebok athletic brand and Dollar General stores, where he created thousands of jobs for hard-working Americans.

You know me as "America's Toughest Sheriff,"" a strong supporter of President Trump, and an unapologetic, tough-on-crime conservative.

**You've stood by my side through thick and thin and I couldn't be more grateful.**

name: Gary Sinise
subject: The National Memorial Day Parade is back
body:
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---
| | | | [](http://trk.freedomfirstproject._c291cmNlX2NvZGU9QUxMMjczNDEifQ/D41yKZXCkEt0k46VD6xcng)
---
Peter, It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like _Apollo 13_ and _The Green Mile_ \- but the role that changed my life, and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders, was as Lt. Dan in _Forrest Gump_. **This year, I'm honored to again serve as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C.** The National Memorial Day Parade is an event like no other ... and this year, the American Veterans Center is bringing it BACK in full force, with 5,000+ participants marching down Constitution Avenue before a crowd of 250,000+ in-person, as well as T.V. broadcast that reaches 100 million households around the country. [**Peter, the National Memorial Day Parade is PRIMARILY FUNDED by private contributions, including from generous Americans like you. Will you help chip in today to help support the Parade with a gift of $25, $50, $75, $150, or more?**](http://trk.freedomfirstproject._c291cmNlX2NvZGU9QUxMMjczNDEifQ/TZRm1CkLvl7pnLxBoXAuVw)
---
[**Support the National Memorial Day Parade**](http://trk.freedomfirstproject._c291cmNlX2NvZGU9QUxMMjczNDEifQ/t8l6LKf4osXWLr2SneFJfA)
---
[](http://trk.freedomfirstproject._c291cmNlX2NvZGU9QUxMMjczNDEifQ/VzgYMnUT3kL5zpP9nlJ1Gg)
---
When the American Veterans Center first called me more than 15 years ago and invited me to the National Memorial Day Parade, I was honored to join the event to remember our fallen heroes. The American Veterans Center revived the Parade in 2005 after it had been dormant for nearly 70 years. Now, in 2022, they're bringing the Parade back to its full-scale glory after two years of pandemic precautions. Every American should be proud that generations of our brave servicemen and servicewomen, from the last of our "Greatest Generation" heroes of World War II to our veterans from Afghanistan and Iraq, will get the public thanks for their service that they deserve this year. But I know that the defenders and families of the fallen who will join me in the National Memorial Day Parade will be thinking of their friends and loved ones who made the ultimate sacrifice for our country - the brave Americans we honor on Memorial Day. **Sadly, our country is losing hundreds of World War II veterans each day, so the mission of the National Memorial Day Parade is _more important now than ever_ \- as this year's event may be the LAST opportunity for our WWII heroes to commemorate their friends who never came home.** [**Please make your most generous contribution of $25, $50, $75, $150, $250, $500, to support the National Memorial Day Parade and make it the tribute that our nation's heroes deserve.**](http://trk.freedomfirstproject._c291cmNlX2NvZGU9QUxMMjczNDEifQ/kUmSqL4tVIaX96k2mj84rw)
---
[**Support the National Memorial Day Parade**](http://trk.freedomfirstproject._c291cmNlX2NvZGU9QUxMMjczNDEifQ/yGuZqcEH8uRpHWIwHCoyPQ)
---
The National Memorial Day Parade costs a fraction of other major public events to put on each year. In fact, _the entire parade_ costs about as much as just THREE balloons in the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade or TWO floats in the Rose Bowl Parade! _That means that every dollar that's contributed by a generous American like you makes a difference for this important event._ Your support of the American Veterans Center not only helps the Parade, but also supports great programs like:
* Record hundreds of oral histories of veterans from World War II to Today before we lose these stories forever.

| Dear Reader, This is troubling. Have you heard of COP26? Almost nobody has. Amid the distractions caused by lingering health issues, conflicts overseas, shortages, and inflation... Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen recently took the stage at COP26 in Glasgow, Scotland to address some of the world's most powerful people, including:
* S. President, Joe Biden...
* British Prime Minister, Boris Johnson...
* Canadian Prime Minister, Justin Trudeau...
* French President Emmanuel Macron...
* ... and many more...

From the stage, Yellen called for world leaders to commit to a $150 trillion 'global transition' of our economy. Since then, Bank of America has signed the accord, along with 131 countries, 234 cities, and 695 of the world's biggest companies. Jeff Bezos and Elon Musk have invested in this 'transformation' as well. What is it that Yellen, Biden, Trudeau, Bezos and Musk are pushing for? And what does it mean for your money? Investigative journalist and renowned economist, Nomi Prins has followed the money... And what she's found is startling. She says: **" While most Americans are distracted by mainstream media headlines calling for a stock market crash, I've found evidence that shows where the elites are spending $150 trillion to 'transform' the economy. Most Americans will be shocked when they see what happens next."** I had to know more, so I scheduled an interview for Nomi to go deeper into the details of this 'transformation.' She agreed to do the interview on one condition: she wanted to record it so she could get her message in front of as many Americans as possible before it's too late. [Go here to see how this ‘transformation’ will play out – and what it means for your money.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zkvf090qrtbmoe6h36a013mhu0d7e2oq9n5d1d3o_rp22sh2s8i66pb4c9h66ob5cth2bs) Regards, Maria Bonaventura

| | Jack Bergman disparages programs his constituency overwhelmingly supports. So, I want to discuss the merits of the child tax credit, universal PreK, and childcare programs in **a town hall for working families** , and give my opponent the opportunity to explain his voting record on childcare. Our district’s average monthly cost of childcare is over $700.00 per child – sometimes costing parents half their salary to work and raise children. To reduce poverty, working families deserve relief. According to Rural Insights, the cost of childcare in six large counties in our district averages $752.04. _**That's $9,024.48 annually for one child.**_ “If you are working at a job paying $10 per hour, you make $20,800 a year, and your child care is almost half of your pay before paying your rent and purchasing family food. If you make $15 per hour, you make $31,200 a year, and your child care costs would take up almost 30% of your budget. “Many families with one, two or more children say their child care costs are more than their rental or mortgage payments. “We hear from many working families... about how childcare is a major issue for them. “The federal child tax credit provides families $3,000 to $3,600 per child (been in existence since March) is set to expire this coming January 1st. Some states already have their own child care tax credits, and some states have existing legislation to provide a child care credit–including Michigan. “The federal and state childcare tax credits have done an excellent job in reducing child poverty in our country. “Whisperers tell us that our federal government and state leaders need to focus on this issue that is so important to working families. If you are concerned about this issue, you can let your federal and state elected leaders know your opinion.” – David Haynes, Rural Insights I support childcare provisions in the BBB Framework because they support us in Northern Michigan and the Upper Peninsula and help us build a better future through the success of our children. In addition to the child tax credit, the BBB legislation also creates childcare and early learning programs for children under six who have not yet started kindergarten. For eligible families who want to participate, this means access to affordable, high-quality childcare in the setting that best meets their needs. For Michigan, it will mean federal funding to support supply-building and a phased-in expansion of income eligibility. It isn’t free. The programs are paid by corporate taxes and taxes on those making over $400,000 annually. Reducing poverty, caring for our children, and providing relief to hard-working families is taxpayer money well-spent. We will see significant economic benefits as it helps parents get back to work and pursue more opportunities for their families. Inaccessible and unaffordable childcare has adverse economic impacts. It causes higher employee absence rates and turnover, postponement of education or training opportunities, reduction of hours, and ultimately, working-parents leaving the workforce. Unfortunately, COVID-19 has only exacerbated the problem. Reliable access to childcare can generate an additional $79,000 in lifetime earnings for parents. In addition, single parents who receive assistance for childcare payments are nearly **40% more likely to maintain employment** over two years than those who do not. **WILL JACK BERGMAN LOOK PARENTS IN THE EYES AND TELL THEM WHY HE OPPOSES AFFORDABLE CHILDCARE?**

body:
This is troubling. Have you heard of COP26? Almost nobody has. [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6824%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=onWOk7aoLlMKXIEScJzzsg&sysid=1)
| Dear Reader, This is troubling. Have you heard of COP26? Almost nobody has. Amid the distractions caused by lingering health issues, conflicts overseas, shortages, and inflation... Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen recently took the stage at COP26 in Glasgow, Scotland to address some of the world’s most powerful people, including:
* S. President, Joe Biden...
* British Prime Minister, Boris Johnson...
* Canadian Prime Minister, Justin Trudeau...
* French President Emmanuel Macron...
* ... and many more...

From the stage, Yellen called for world leaders to commit to a $150 trillion ‘global transition’ of our economy. Since then, Bank of America has signed the accord, along with 131 countries, 234 cities, and 695 of the world’s biggest companies. Jeff Bezos and Elon Musk have invested in this ‘transformation’ as well. What is it that Yellen, Biden, Trudeau, Bezos and Musk are pushing for? And what does it mean for your money? Investigative journalist and renowned economist, Nomi Prins has followed the money... And what she’s found is startling. She says: **“While most Americans are distracted by mainstream media headlines calling for a stock market crash, I’ve found evidence that shows where the elites are spending $150 trillion to ‘transform’ the economy. Most Americans will be shocked when they see what happens next.”** I had to know more, so I scheduled an interview for Nomi to go deeper into the details of this ‘transformation.’ She agreed to do the interview on one condition: she wanted to record it so she could get her message in front of as many Americans as possible before it’s too late. [Go here to see how this ‘transformation’ will play out - and what it means for your money. ](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c60322%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=BsjYi1Ej9gYKP2BdvLSp9g&sysid=1) Regards, Maria Bonaventura
Senior Managing Editor, _Distortion Report_

She could be questioning Dr. Fauci's dangerous Gain-of-Function research.

It's why I've spent my professional life as a lawyer battling Big Government and federal agencies trying to usurp our rights, and why I'll do it in Washington, too.

* 100% Pro-Life
* A strong supporter of our Second Amendment
* Totally and Completely Against Vaccine Mandates
* Believe in the need to fight for our Election Integrity
* A believer in our fight for election integrity
* Committed to government transparency and ending wasteful spending!

My friend, these are the issues conservatives need to put front and center: _Not_ joining Nancy Pelosi in some anti-American tribunal designed to persecute fellow Americans!

My friend, I started by telling you how, out here in my home state of Wyoming, loyalty and freedom still mean something.

And even though you may not live here, I hope these values mean something to you, too. I look forward to your response. And I want to thank you for your support.

Respectfully,

Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen recently took the stage at COP26 in Glasgow, Scotland to address some of the world's most powerful people, including:
* S. President, Joe Biden...
* British Prime Minister, Boris Johnson...
* Canadian Prime Minister, Justin Trudeau...
* French President Emmanuel Macron...
* ... and many more...

From the stage, Yellen called for world leaders to commit to a $150 trillion 'global transition' of our economy. Since then, Bank of America has signed the accord, along with 131 countries, 234 cities, and 695 of the world's biggest companies. Friend -- There have been a lot of positive headlines lately about how Democrats have fared better than expected in redistricting. And it’s true! Thanks to the support of people like you, we’ve had some big wins this cycle.

But while that might lead you to think our job is over, that would be far from the truth! Our work is happening in states all over the country, because we know that we can’t afford to give up fair maps in _any_ state if we’re going to keep making progress on key issues and protect our democracy.

Thanks to your support, the NDRC has made an immeasurable difference from coast to coast since our launch in 2017. name: Jim DeMint
subject: Stop the Left's Grooming
body:
Fellow Conservative:

The Left is sick. There's no other explanation.
The Vast Left-Wing Conspiracy to sexualize young children, long hidden, is now out in the open for all to see.
Judge Ketanji Brown Jackson's appalling record of leniency toward sexual abuse and child pornography is the story of her Supreme Court nomination.
Her anti-Constitution judicial philosophy is enough for any conservative to oppose her, but her record on sex offenders is different. Jackson repeatedly reduced prison sentences for men convicted of abusing children and using child porn.
The Left says it's no big deal, just a misunderstanding. Then why did the White House withhold documents about those cases? Why did the Senate rush her nomination vote? Because time and again, Judge Jackson sided with child predators over the wishes of prosecutors, federal
guidelines, and victims' families.
Jackson's creepy affinity for child abusers is matched by the Left's bizarre outrage about the Florida law prohibiting public schools from teaching students about transgenderism and sexual transitioning until the 4th grade. Woke socialists around the country are mad because
apparently, this is what they want to teach kindergarteners!
Now leaked videos from a Disney staff meeting show an executive producer bragging about "adding queerness" to children's programming as part of a "not-at-all-secret gay agenda."
Enough!

Please help CPI stop it by training, equipping, and uniting conservatives in the fight for our values!
What the Left is doing is not advocacy - it's perverted.

It doesn't matter if it's billion-dollar corporations or Supreme Court judges; sexualizing kids is an abusive violation of parents' and children's rights. We have a moral duty to stop it. The Left's obsession with sexualizing our kids has no place in civilized society, and it's
time to take the gloves off.
As you know, the Conservative Partnership Institute has been leading the fights against corporate porn peddlers, including Big Tech, and trans extremism in our schools and sports leagues.
This fight won't end with the Senate's confirmation of Judge Jackson's nomination. Or when the controversy in Florida dies down. Progressives have crossed a line and need to be exposed - and defeated.
Please help protect our kids and destroy the kindergarten-grooming Left by supporting CPI today!
We don't work for a party - we work for patriots, in Congress, in the conservative movement, and within the grassroots across the country. True conservatives know how to fight. We teach them how to win.
Thank you for being part of our team and for doing so much to help secure America's future.

For Freedom,

Jim DeMintCPI Chairman

_**" I make a hard distinction between Black conservatives and these tokens [Herschel Walker and Senator Tim Scott], who are out here right now, shucking and jiving for their white handlers."**
--Eli Mystal, MSNBC_

Peter,

I recently wrote to you about a racist article attacking me in _The Nation_.

The author had some pretty heinous things to say because I'm a Black conservative. You may recall this line:

_" Herschel Walker's candidacy is a white insult to Black people."_
Well, Peter, he's back at it again. MSNBC featured this man on their network this week so he could spew even more anti-Black, anti-conservative vitriol in the name of mediocre TV ratings.

He doubled down in his attacks on me. This time he attacked Republican Senator Tim Scott (SC) too. Here's part of what he said:

_" I make a hard distinction between Black conservatives and these tokens [referring to me and Senator Tim Scott], who are out here right now, shucking and jiving for their white handlers." _
**That's racist, disgusting, and sad.**

I never wanted the color of my skin to be a focal point of this Senate campaign, but these attacks on my character and my skin color have gone too far.

**You can help me prove them wrong by standing with me at this critical moment.**

We'd like to show them a groundswell of grassroots support from across Georgia and around the country. **[Can I count on you to help me today?](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60262522:JC9e1doFN:m:1:3317145305:95457567F71AB4FFEF63DD33CB2D033F:r)**

_Just imagine if these comments were made by a conservative about a Black Democrat. They'd be fired immediately after going off air._

**I won't be quiet about this.** This columnist is saying horrible things about fellow human beings based on the color of their skin. That's simply wrong.

**[We hope you'll take a moment today to support our Senate campaign and show the people who want us to fail just how much support there is for Black conservatives in this country.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60262522:JC9e1doFN:m:1:3317145305:95457567F71AB4FFEF63DD33CB2D033F:r)**

Thanks,

Herschel Walker

| For immediate release April 29th, 2022 I will end Biden's border surge
Jake Evans, the America First conservative running for the 6th Congressional District, said when he joins the House majority next year that he'll prioritize reversing the unlawful and harmful Biden administration policies that will lead to a surge of illegal immigration this year. "The Biden administration can't take a firm stand on whether the pandemic poses a public health threat," said Jake. "It is decided on a case-by-case basis, depending on what the far left of the Democratic Party is demanding. When it comes to virtue-signaling by demanding masks on planes, they think COVID restrictions should outweigh personal liberty. But when it comes to allowing a surge of untested illegal immigrants pouring into our country, the administration seems to think the pandemic is over - even though U.S. citizens traveling abroad still must get a negative COVID test to come home." Department of Homeland Security officials expect 18,000 migrants a day to come to the border every day if Biden lifts the Title 42 policy. "When I get to Congress, I expect the Republican majority to prioritize border security, and put a stop to illegal immigration and the human trafficking, drug smuggling, and violent gang crime that come with it," Jake said. "Many didn't believe us when we said that Biden would push for an open borders policy, but now there's no doubt and we must stop it to save America."

_**" I make a hard distinction between Black conservatives and these tokens [Herschel Walker and Senator Tim Scott], who are out here right now, shucking and jiving for their white handlers."**
--Eli Mystal, MSNBC_

Peter,

I recently wrote to you about a racist article attacking me in _The Nation_.

The author had some pretty heinous things to say because I'm a Black conservative. You may recall this line:

_" Herschel Walker's candidacy is a white insult to Black people."_
Well, Peter, he's back at it again. MSNBC featured this man on their network this week so he could spew even more anti-Black, anti-conservative vitriol in the name of mediocre TV ratings.

He doubled down in his attacks on me. This time he attacked Republican Senator Tim Scott (SC) too. Here's part of what he said:

_" I make a hard distinction between Black conservatives and these tokens [referring to me and Senator Tim Scott], who are out here right now, shucking and jiving for their white handlers." _
**That's racist, disgusting, and sad.**

I never wanted the color of my skin to be a focal point of this Senate campaign, but these attacks on my character and my skin color have gone too far.

**You can help me prove them wrong by standing with me at this critical moment.**

We'd like to show them a groundswell of grassroots support from across Georgia and around the country. **[Can I count on you to help me today?](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60262550:JYqqCdo-N:m:1:3253819041:7521EA343DCC6C931AB02266090E24E9:r)**

_Just imagine if these comments were made by a conservative about a Black Democrat. They'd be fired immediately after going off air._

**I won't be quiet about this.** This columnist is saying horrible things about fellow human beings based on the color of their skin. That's simply wrong.

**[We hope you'll take a moment today to support our Senate campaign and show the people who want us to fail just how much support there is for Black conservatives in this country.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60262550:JYqqCdo-N:m:1:3253819041:7521EA343DCC6C931AB02266090E24E9:r)**

Thanks,

Herschel Walker

Know your rights at the polls
Voting has never been more convenient and secure in Pennsylvania. Despite all the noise, misinformation and disinformation, our freedom to vote is protected because many of our leaders believe in democracy and have expanded access to the ballot box.

Important things to remember
If you have requested a mail-in ballot and you don’t receive your ballot in time to vote-by-mail, you can cast your ballot provisionally at your polling location.
If you want to vote in person (but have already requested your ballot) you still can — bring your ballot and the outer declaration envelope into the voting center with you and sign a declaration surrendering your ballot.
If you face any difficulties voting or just have a question about casting your ballot, call 866-OUR-VOTE, the nonpartisan voter election hotline.
Your vote is your voice: use it. For more voting information and resources, visit our website [https://www.newpaproject.org/know-your-rights-at-the-polls/] .

Hey Peter,
Like the title says, I'm not your typical kind of candidate and I'm proud of that.
I haven't worked in politics or as a lawyer my entire career. In fact, I've been a pipefitter welder for the better part of the last decade.
I'm just a blue-collar working guy who can see the direction our state and our country are headed in and decided to stand up and do something about it.
I'm not running because going to Washington has been a dream of mine for my entire life. I'm also not running to become famous or write a book about my campaign.
I'm running for Congress because I've served my country all my life and I realize that now is the right time for me to step up and serve again.
I'm doing this to solve the problems affecting everyday Minnesotans who are struggling with out of control economic problems and having their rights and freedoms trampled by massive government overreach into our lives.
If that sounds refreshing to you and if you think I'd be a strong representative for our district, please consider chipping in and donating to my campaign.

body:
| | |

Friend: This is a longer, but especially important, email about why I'm running for Senate. It's important for me to share my story with you and why this campaign means so much to me. I hope you'll give it a read.
I was raised in Jacksonville, FL – and I've got to say, when you grow up in the South poor, Black and female, you've got to have faith. It's something I learned from my parents. Mom was a maid, Dad was a janitor, and my goodness they worked hard. And although we didn't have a lot of money – although life was tough sometimes – we had each other. We had love. We had _faith_. I've carried that spirit with me my entire career.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44704371/342747053/580313503?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3382-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzNDYzYzE3MC1jNWM3LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8tK35q1GgdiBgEozArTCjtQFdLAFg7T9DbMq221IGSI=)
That faith that things can get better, that we can do some good in the world, inspired me to get into public service. In fact, my mom used to say to me: "Never grow tired of doing good, Val — _never_ tire." And so for me, growing tired was never an option. It's what pushed me to become the first in my family to graduate college. It's also what pushed me to serve 27 years in the Orlando Police Department, where eventually I became the first woman to lead the department. And it pushed me to run for Congress and represent my community.
I will never tire of the opportunities to do good or the challenges to tackle before me, and I'm asking you to do the same. Pitch in a split contribution of $5 or more now between my reelection campaign and Kirsten Gillibrand's and to help me defeat Marco Rubio, win in Florida and defend our Senate majority.
_Never tire._ These are the words that resonate in my mind each and every day that I serve the people of Florida's 10th District in Congress. They've stuck with me as I've fought to put an end to gun violence, as the horror of that violence struck our district at Pulse Nightclub in Orlando. We mourned, deeply. But we resolved to fight for change, to never tire – and I won't stop until long-overdue action on gun violence is finally realized.
_Never tire_ , I said to myself, as I took on a habitual offender who occupied the most powerful office in the world: President Donald Trump. Unlike some in Washington, I never tire of standing up for what I believe is right, and I carried that with me as I fought to impeach him, because no one is above the law.
This is my story, friend: Only in America can a little Black girl, the daughter of a maid and a janitor growing up in the South in the '60s, have a story so filled with opportunities like these. Now, I'm ready to meet a new moment, to do more good for Floridians. **I am ready to be the next U.S. Senator for Florida – and together, with you never tiring alongside me, I know we can win.**
**So I need your support, friend. This campaign is a battle of many things, and an unfortunate reality among them is** _resources_**. The Republican Party is already proving they will spend whatever it takes to protect Marco Rubio, so if you're with me, if you want to elect Florida's first Black senator and first Black woman senator and defend our majority in the Senate, please split a donation of $5 or whatever you can between me and Kirsten Gillibrand before our end of month deadline. **

Now, I'm ready to meet a new moment, to do more good for Floridians. I am ready to be the next U.S. Senator for Florida – and together, with you never tiring alongside me, I know we can win. So I need your support, friend. This campaign is a battle of many things, and an unfortunate reality among them is resources. The Republican Party is already proving they will spend whatever it takes to protect Marco Rubio, so if you're with me, if you want to elect Florida's first Black senator and first Black woman senator and defend our majority in the Senate, please split a donation of $5 or whatever you can between me and Kirsten Gillibrand before our end of month deadline. If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately and be split between Val Demings and Kirsten Gillibrand: | | | = | = | | = | = Thank you for being in this with me. Never tire._ Val Demings | This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Click here to . | Dear Friend,
The Senate President has indicated that the Senate will take up a bill to provide driver's licenses to illegal immigrants next week.
I staunchly oppose the issuance of driver's licenses to illegal immigrants, and I am particularly concerned that the Legislature is moving ahead with plans to issue these licenses at the same time the Biden Administration is proposing to end Title 42. There is a profound risk of a sudden influx of illegal immigrants across our nation's porous borders, and a danger that they will immediately have access to rights and privileges here in Massachusetts that are normally reserved for citizens of the Commonwealth.
I am calling on the Biden Administration to keep Title 42 in place and to take additional steps to secure our nation's borders. I am also calling on state officials to suspend any plans to issue driver's licenses to illegal immigrants.
Beyond this, I am calling on federal and state officials to immediately release information on how many illegal immigrants have been transported to Massachusetts in each month since January 1, 2021, which communities they were transported to, and what plans the government has for such transportation over the next twelve months. If our state has any designs of giving driver's licenses to illegal immigrants - which I flatly oppose as a matter of public safety - then the citizens of our state have a clear right to know where these immigrants will be located if and when they are transported to Massachusetts.
Thank you for your support.
Sincerely,

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear
fellow American,

Inflation
is on the rise in America. And there's no sign of it slowing
down.

In
February, consumer prices rose 7.9 percent-the highest annual
inflation rate increase since January 1982.

Economic
historian John Steele Gordon discussed inflation in a recent
issue of Imprimis, Hillsdale College's digest of liberty. And he
noted that adding trillions more to the national debt is not the
solution. In fact, it will only make the problem worse.

Nevertheless, support for socialism and other ideologies
destructive of the free market also appears to be on the rise in
our country, especially among younger Americans.

That's
why you're receiving this email today.

Hillsdale
College seeks to understand more clearly what Americans think
about our nation's economy and the inflation we're experiencing.
And I'm hoping you can help by completing our National Survey on
Inflation in the United States using the secure link below:

https://lp.hillsdale.edu/national-survey-on-inflation/

The
survey will take you only a few minutes to complete. But the
results will help us develop an effective strategy to educate
millions of Americans about free market economics.

This
educational effort is critical to reining in the growing appetite
in Washington, D.C., to print more money to pay for
ever-expanding government programs.

We think
education is the surest way to reverse this dangerous trend. And
your partnership with Hillsdale College is vital as we expand our
efforts to defend liberty nationwide by reaching and teaching
millions.

So please
don't wait.

Share
your opinions on inflation and the state of our nation's economy
by completing the National Survey on Inflation in the United
States using this secure link:
https://lp.hillsdale.edu/national-survey-on-inflation/.

Warm
regards,

Larry P.
Arnn

President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing
Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

P.S.
Inflation in the United States is on the rise. We need your
opinions to develop an effective strategy to educate millions of
Americans about this growing threat to liberty.

Please
complete our National Survey on Inflation in the United States
using the secure link below:

https://lp.hillsdale.edu/national-survey-on-inflation/

Peter, As a physician of more than two decades, an advocate for the Affordable Care Act, and the chair of the board of commissioners for Pennsylvania's third-largest county, I know firsthand how important it is to use data and facts to make decisions. And we’re in the middle of an all-out assault on science and facts that's only grown worse in recent years. **[I will always be ready to help battle back against attacks on science and facts because there is too much at stake. If you're with me, let me know where you stand.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44709591/342767968/-56641390?ms=em22_220426_choice_adv_gq_ful___va_ettx&refcode=em22_220426_choice_adv_gq_ful___va_ettx&source=em22_220426_choice_adv_gq_ful___va_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_220426_choice_adv_gq_ful___va_ettx&utm_medium=email&contactdata=Vhh2Un%2FKxq0bEDrCEGUW%2F8MmPEjkmwcNd8lzh1SPXrcXR%2F%2BDtzOXfEPhTycMhQp%2B1KJ3YlIGwOoTy0gzfaTSVYSaNIBIvvIkGlG7Ujbax9nFxQQk9of16WwE%2B9FuO9NoiCINVPpt52ZGCVh3%2FK5uD0Qsj0PZdn0SE66kYAtmNSw%3D&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTcwOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlMGJjNzBkMi1jZGM3LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=FjjlrY-sUG98iI5HZx1qPW43ij4APP6iN0S0w5ZKXrA=&emci=16b53d99-a3c5-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=e0bc70d2-cdc7-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=5086640)** We face an uphill battle in fighting climate change due to these attacks. We are losing Americans to extreme temperatures. Parents have to worry about the air their kids breathe and the water they drink. And yet every day, people in positions of power continue to undermine our efforts to address this, openly questioning science. They deny that vaccines work against COVID-19. They deny that the disease is even real and in doing so make it harder for us to protect the lives and health of our friends and neighbors. They misrepresent medical facts, or ignore them altogether, to push an anti-abortion agenda that is punishing pregnant people and the physicians and medical personnel who help them by making it harder and in some cases nearly impossible to access abortion services. As someone who spent countless hours on the labor and delivery floor, I have seen firsthand the challenges and stigma Pennsylvanians and Americans face in accessing abortion and reproductive health care. I also understand the consequences of taking away abortion access and the ability of pregnant people to make these decisions with their doctors. It's just wrong. It's more urgent than ever that we not only codify Roe v. Wade but also expand abortion access by making it available at no cost to anyone who needs or wants it. We must also expand access to the full range of reproductive health care, including making contraception available over the counter at no cost. Defending abortion care and reproductive freedom is central to the fight to defend science and truth. We must stand together for abortion care and demand action to protect it. And we must elect more people to office, especially women, who will make this a priority. name: Steven Olikara
subject: Empowering Working People to Run for Office
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Olikara for Senate
body:
Image of Olikara campaign logo with photo of Steven Olikara and link to campaign website:
[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP30/1/90801/images/OfS%20logo%20w%20headshot.png]
[https://www.stevenolikara.com]

Image of Milwaukee Journal Sentinel headline that reads, "Democratic U.S. Senate candidate Steven Olikara unveils 'agenda to make government work' "with link to article:
[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP30/1/90801/images/MJS_Headline_Agenda_Exhaused_Majority.jpeg]
[https://www.jsonline.com/story/news/politics/elections/2022/04/21/wisconsin-democrat-steven-olikara-running-u-s-senate-seat/7388061001/]

Dear Peter,

We need better options in our politics. It’s a broken system, and over 80% of Wisconsinites [https://law.marquette.edu/poll/2021/08/11/new-marquette-law-school-poll-finds-majorities-of-wisconsin-voters-approve-how-biden-and-evers-are-handling-coronavirus-issues/] , the Exhausted Majority, agree. Our agenda to make government work [http://stevenolikara.com/vision#exhaustedmajority] seeks to empower working people in government and we’re excited to have it featured in the Milwaukee Journal Sentinel [https://www.jsonline.com/story/news/politics/elections/2022/04/21/wisconsin-democrat-steven-olikara-running-u-s-senate-seat/7388061001/] .

If you want to help fix our broken political system, please support our campaign with a financial contribution. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/steven_olikara_for_us_senate_email?refcode=0429email]

Button that says "Support Our Campaign" with link to campaign donation page: [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/steven_olikara_for_us_senate_email?refcode=0429email]

As your next U.S. Senator, I’ll promote greater collaboration in Congress and fair elections by enacting Final Five Voting and ending partisan gerrymandering. Both of these measures ensure the people serving us in government are responsive to our needs because they provide the means for us to hold them accountable at the ballot box. I’ll also empower working class people and non-traditional candidates to run for office by passing a Citizens’ Elections Program based on the highly successful Connecticut Citizens’ Elections Program (passed by my organization, the Millennial Action Project). Learn about these initiatives and more in our recent proposal to make government work for Wisconsin’s Exhausted Majority [https://stevenolikara.com/vision#exhaustedmajority].

Image of U.S. Capitol Rotunda with caption that reads, "Our Agenda to Change the Business Model of Politics: Make Government Work for Wisconsin's Exhausted Majority" and link to policy paper: [http://StevenOlikara.com/vision#exhaustedmajority]

I successfully convened the bipartisan co-sponsors of the Final Five Voting bill in Wisconsin’s state legislature and I’m the only candidate in this race who supports it. Final Five Voting is a “ranked voting” method where the top five candidates are selected from the primary election and instant runoff voting is used to identify the winner in the general election. You can learn more about Final Five Voting here: [https://democracyfound.org/] .

I’m also the only candidate who has a successful track record of passing gerrymandering reforms and a plan for making nonpartisan redistricting a reality nationwide. As Founder and CEO of the Millennial Action Project, we successfully built state-level caucuses to end partisan gerrymandering and worked with members of Congress to secure bipartisan support for nonpartisan redistricting.
[http://StevenOlikara.com/vision#exhaustedmajority [http://StevenOlikara.com/vision#exhaustedmajority]

Image of Steven Olikara in front of a group of campaign volunteers holding signs with campaign logo. Image includes link to campaign donation page:
[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP30/1/90801/images/4th_July_Group.jpg]
[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/steven_olikara_for_us_senate_email?refcode=0429email]

If you agree with our agenda and want to help create positive change for Wisconsin, please contribute to our campaign [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/steven_olikara_for_us_senate_email?refcode=0429email] .

Button that says "Help Create Positive Change for Wisconsin." with link to campaign donation page: [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/steven_olikara_for_us_senate_email?refcode=0429email]

This spring offers a great opportunity to increase awareness of our campaign by collecting signatures from our family, friends and neighbors to get our name on the ballot for the August 9th primary election. Please reply “Yes” to this email if you can ask family and friends to sign our nomination papers. If that’s not possible, please consider making a donation to help us get the word out. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/steven_olikara_for_us_senate_email?refcode=0429email]

Thank you for supporting our efforts and for sharing the message of our campaign.

With Heartfelt Gratitude for Your Support,
Steven

We need your help to gather the signatures necessary to get on the ballot for the August 9th primary. Please reply "YES" to this email if you can ask friends and family to sign our nomination papers or click the button below to send us an email.

Friend,
We’re in a race to the primary right now, and the biggest hurdle of this campaign remains small dollar donations. We have until midnight tonight to reach our end-of-April goal, can you help? [http://secure.ngpvan.com/t_OakHAu1Eyexxm3ZVTwZw2]
If you’ve been following this campaign, you know that at our core we are a movement to put community over politics. That’s why we aren’t accepting donations from corporations and political organizations. That’s why we are taking on issues that other politicians won’t touch.
Our communities are in crisis. Violence and crime numbers are rising. Dilapidated buildings are left to decompose as current leadership looks the other way.
It’s time to invest in Marylanders. If Nancy and I win, we are going to take on the violence. We are going to build back up the infrastructure to support our communities and tackle root causes of crime, just like I did as Prince George’s County Executive.
We are going all in, but we need our supporters to do the same. Can you donate today, and help support a movement for Maryland’s future? [http://secure.ngpvan.com/t_OakHAu1Eyexxm3ZVTwZw2]

That's why I've dedicated my whole career to serving the communities that raised me. After decades of public service, I became the first Democratic Hispanic woman to serve as Governor.
In the last three years, I have safeguarded reproductive rights, legalized cannabis, slashed taxes for working families, and signed a bill to provide free higher education for all New Mexico students.
I accomplished all of this and so much more with a massive grassroots team behind me – but to continue passing some of the boldest, most progressive policies in the country, I need your support now.

**[If I don't catch up on fundraising this month, the GOP could take control. subject: What would Reagan say?

body:
| | | | [ ](https://heimlichforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=93d2b220a5efc44f0b96119a2&id=22b8c2f41f&e=544bb4cd89)
---
| | |
---
| Peter, I’ve been thinking a lot about President Ronald Reagan lately and can’t help wondering: What would the 40th president of the United States think of a Congressman who speaks up for Vladimir Putin instead of supporting Ukraine?

We all remember President Reagan’s powerful stand against Soviet oppression in 1987 when he declared at Berlin’s Brandenburg Gate, “Mr. Gorbachev, tear down this wall!” How would Reagan have responded to my opponent, Warren Davidson, who stated there were “grains of truth” in Vladimir Putin’s justification of his bloody war against Ukraine? Or when Davidson said he agreed with the dictator that there are neo-Nazis in Ukraine? Or when he boasted about voting against military and humanitarian aid for Ukraine and criticized U.S. sanctions against Russia?

What would Reagan, whose administration brought about the demise of the Soviet Union, think of the six members of Congress—a group that includes Davidson and who President Trump’s former Homeland Security chief of staff called “Vlad’s Cover-Up Crew”—who voted against investigating and preserving evidence of Russian war crimes in Ukraine?

Reagan opposed and rejected the support of organizations that promoted crackpot conspiracy theories. Imagine how disgusted he’d be with the 18 members of Congress (again, including Davidson) who voted against condemning the conspiracy movement QAnon, one that the FBI has labeled a “potential domestic terrorism threat.”

President Reagan believed in the rule of law. Quite a contrast to Rep. Davidson who’s currently under federal investigation for violating securities laws by failing to disclose stock trades involving an electric vehicle manufacturer being investigated by the Securities and Exchange Commission. What’s worse is that the SEC is overseen by the House Financial Services Committee on which Davidson sits.

**My campaign for Congress is based on the principle of protecting democracy from those who seek to tear it down ****— ****both at home and abroad.** Like President Reagan, I am committed to preserving free and fair elections and upholding the rule of law. You know me as a law-and-order Republican. As a prosecutor, I went after criminals, regardless of their political influence or party affiliation. As a member of Congress, I’ll do everything in my power to stop foreign aggression in its tracks.

Friends, we are down to the wire. **_This is our chance to prevent a member of the Putin wing of Congress from making it to the general election._ **There’s still time for each one of us to make an impact on this election. Here’s how:
* Please [contribute to my campaign](https://heimlichforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=93d2b220a5efc44f0b96119a2&id=b17337cbe7&e=544bb4cd89) today.
* Contact everyone you know on Cincinnati’s West Side and in Butler, Preble and Warren counties and encourage them to vote for me.
* Share news about our campaign on [Facebook](https://heimlichforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=93d2b220a5efc44f0b96119a2&id=2e0317cad3&e=544bb4cd89) and [Twitter](https://heimlichforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=93d2b220a5efc44f0b96119a2&id=74b3f75824&e=544bb4cd89).
* Not a Republican? Go to the polls on Tuesday, request a Republican ballot, and vote for me. It’s permissible and doesn’t preclude you from voting for whoever you like in November.

As always, I am grateful for your support!
---
|
---
| | | | OUTRAGE OF THE WEEK
---
| My opponent is so fixated on undermining the people of Ukraine that he was recently [named](https://heimlichforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=93d2b220a5efc44f0b96119a2&id=b44abc637d&e=544bb4cd89) a member of the GOP’s “Pro-Russian-War-Crimes Caucus.” The Reason? He opposed a pro-NATO resolution partly because some parts highlighted the alliance’s commitment to “democratic principles.” On Tuesday, let's vote out the Putin apologist and vote me in, a pro-democracy Republican!

There is no time to lose. We need your help today to reach every voter before they return their ballot by mail or vote in person on June 7th. | | | Hi Peter,

I'm Mark, and I work for the Washington Circle donor club at House Republicans HQ.

I'm not really supposed to do this, but you've always been a top supporter, so I thought I'd make an exception just this one time. _**[Accept your Washington Circle invitation HERE>>>](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60265011:6prrIdobN:m:1:3253819041:6F8528AEADF2D4C92AFE74B0F6593130:r "Accept your

Best,

Mark

I have some good news and some bad news for you.

**First, the good news:** _The Washington Post_ reported that I’m “the best chance to rid the Senate of Ron Johnson.” And the most recent head-to-head survey from a top-rated _FiveThirtyEight_ pollster shows I’m the only Democrat who can defeat.

Our momentum is growing — we see it in the polls, the press, and the energy on the ground. Everywhere I go, folks tell me how fed up they are with this guy, and I gotta tell you: I’m right there with them!

I’m frustrated with Ron Johnson’s refusal to fight for good-paying jobs, affordable childcare, and lower costs for working families. And I’m tired of our Senate majority getting blocked at every turn. That's why I got in this fight, and it’s clear our campaign is in the strongest position to defeat him and grow our majority.

**Now, here's the bad news:** The latest ActBlue report shows us tracking behind our April fundraising goal by about 13%. Look, these goals are not arbitrary — we need to meet every single one of them in order to stay on track for our end-of-month deadline.

I’m hoping at least every one in three people who open this email will make a contribution today. Every dollar makes a difference, and it all adds up when a lot of folks are pitching in. Can I count on you to be one of those people today?

We couldn’t be more excited about our latest hire as we expand our outreach efforts to Hispanic communities in the Fourth District. We’re working to translate _all_ of our campaign literature and digital content into Spanish, as well as developing relationships with local organizations and organizers.

[Doug is committed to ensuring EVERYONE has a voice in our campaign for Congress – but he needs your support to keep up those efforts. Can you contribute before our budget deadline on Saturday?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44717425/342803450/-1439264559?amount=10&refcode=DW_EM_FR_30DO_220429_1_2&refcode2=72541486-e1c7-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&contactdata=4aV6xNnCGfR0eEi3bLRGPkmaZLEBk0WdK14iHeIPvCXARrxFw6tvwJ5KBWmbeeLS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzUwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MjU0MTQ4Ni1lMWM3LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=mN63mrBwEQfR0IuwHJvFtGPC2ZSaVtPCTFJuAsPx_cw=)

Lindsey, Campaign Manager

In the coming months, my campaign must expand our reach and continue to hire staff so that every voter in the Fourth District hears my message and understands that we can have a representative who puts working families above petty political fights.

subject: He had nowhere else to turn
body:
I’m coming to you with an urgent request... [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6842%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=5Z2oSDp1xpsEd31Z4%2bAT8Q&sysid=1)

|
[](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c60470%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=gYdoLDP7pzSWX4mNZth6nA&sysid=1)
**SPECIAL AGENT EDDIE VALDIVIA DEFENSE FUND**

**_LESS THAN ONE MONTH TO TRIAL_**
**GOAL: $75,000**

[_**MAKE MY GIFT TO DEFEND SA EDDIE VALDIVIA TODAY >>**_](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c60471%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=GqkUPTe8q98UhPXd%2fcL4Yw&sysid=1)

I’m coming to you with an urgent request...
[](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c60472%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=v3YpTeDDlIql2YqfpeEpAQ&sysid=1)
Next month, Special Agent Eddie Valdivia will head into court.

He was wrongfully charged with Attempted Second-Degree Murder and Felony Assault for defending himself from being hurt or killed by a mentally deranged criminal in 2020.

Backed into a corner, Eddie had to use self-defense to prevent this repeat felon from punching him in the face and taking his service weapon where he could have hurt other innocent people nearby.

Now, he might spend over a decade in prison for it... INSTEAD of the repeat felon who made the threat.

[**Will you help him afford the best possible legal defense so he's not wrongfully convicted at his trial next month?**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c60473%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=nb71XlRcugrHkm9v6nzaqQ&sysid=1)

[>> DEFEND SPECIAL AGENT EDDIE VALDIVIA <<](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c60474%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=51LvLohzyCEwxQQikRqcSw&sysid=1)
Early in the morning of December 15th, Eddie boarded the subway train station near his home to head into work in Washington D.C.

A few stops into Eddie’s commute, a man named Steven Slaughter got on the train, sat next to him, and aggressively demanded that Eddie to give him money.

Eddie refused - and Slaughter immediately started cursing him out and hurling racial insults.

Eventually, Slaughter calmed down - but only for a brief moment.

A few minutes later, Slaughter again confronted Eddie - **and this time he was looking for a fight.**

You see, Eddie Valdivia is expert when it comes to assessing threats.

As an experienced law enforcement agent, he recognized that he was about to be assaulted by a much larger man who may be under the influence of drugs. He also knew that he was armed and, if he became incapacitated, he could be disarmed and killed.

With that in mind - _and the fact that Slaughter had backed him into the corner of the train car_ - Eddie knew he would have to take action to stop this possibly unstable convicted criminal from hurting him and perhaps others.

So, when Eddie realized that he was about to be assaulted by Slaughter, he pulled out his service weapon and fired three times.

As soon as the train stopped at the next station, they got off the train car and Eddie told a nearby witness to call 911 so that Slaughter could get urgent medical help.

_Even though Slaughter was hurt badly at the time, he was still able to walk off the train and has since recovered._

But the most shocking part of the entire incident happened a few days later when Eddie found out that he was charged with Attempted Second-Degree Murder and felony assault.

Eddie had no choice but to defend himself when he was cornered and threatened by a deranged criminal - and yet somehow, he is the one who might spend decades in prison for it.

That’s why I’m asking for your help today.

In a few short weeks, Eddie will head into court for his trial. May 23rd to be exact.

And as we do with any wrongfully charged or accused officer, the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF) is helping Eddie afford the best attorneys, pay for the court fees, and make sure expert witnesses are there to clear his name.

**In total, it’s going to cost us close to $75,000.**

[**That’s why I’m asking you to contribute just $25 or more to the LELDF today to help us cover Eddie’s legal costs and make sure he isn’t wrongfully convicted for this absurd charge.**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c60485%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=WYWFf7rEdAVZBWGkP%2b4tsA&sysid=1)

[>> MAKE MY GIFT: DEFEND SA EDDIE VALDIVIA <<](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c60486%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=rMl9OqWIqqwcik7S%2fTkpSw&sysid=1)
Like I mentioned earlier, there is plenty of evidence to support what _actually_ happened that morning.

There was even a witness on the train who saw this dangerous confrontation up close.

And never mind the fact that Eddie’s attacker - Steven Slaughter - has been convicted at least nine times before with indecent exposure, drug possession, assault, and resisting arrest.

Yet it’s Eddie who might be locked up instead of this career criminal.

Friend, these are the moments when our nation’s law enforcement officers need your help most.

The thin-blue line that protects our communities from violence and anarchy is under attack in America today.

From the anti-cop politicians slashing police budgets...

To the radical protesters burning down cities and chanting "DEFUND THE POLICE..."

To the progressive District Attorneys who are trying to lock up good cops and put violent criminals back on the streets...

"Backing the blue” isn’t just about waving the thin-blue-line flag on your front porch or sharing your support for cops on social media...

It's helping good, honest, hard-working law enforcement officers like Special Agent Eddie Valdivia avoid being financially ruined or unjustly convicted by anti-cop politicians, prosecutors, and bureaucrats.

And by helping good officers like Eddie avoid wrongful prosecution, you’re helping them do the job they were trained to do and keep our communities safe.

[**Please help us clear Special Agent Eddie Valdivia’s name by sending a tax-deductible gift of any amount today.**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c60487%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=xCnnRHAUSP8hpc1t03H0BA&sysid=1)

[>> MAKE MY GIFT: DEFEND SA EDDIE VALDIVIA <<](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c60486%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=rMl9OqWIqqwcik7S%2fTkpSw&sysid=1)
And as always, thank you for everything you do on behalf of our nation’s heroic cops and first responders.

Sincerely,
[](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c60488%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=g%2fOO1lOFls3w8ZC7Vd075g&sysid=1)
Jason Johnson
President, LELDF

[DONATE TO THE LELDF](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c60489%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=UVWqnz5YoqGK0KfTRLP5Sw&sysid=1)

* * *

More such officers who sacrifice so much for us will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other law enforcement officers we're defending, please visit www.leldf.org. And remember -- Blue Lives Matter!
---

subject: I think about that day a lot

body:
Three weeks after the tragedy at Sandy Hook Elementary School, I went to Newtown
#

[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/giffords-em-apr22?refcode=em220429-1-15&refcode2=1893.3935704.Q_EfKN&t=1&akid=1893%2E3935704%2EQ_EfKN)
---
_My visit to Newtown, Connecticut._
Friends -
Three weeks after the tragedy at Sandy Hook Elementary School, I went to Newtown and met personally with many of the families who lost loved ones, and others who had kids in the school that day.
I’ve thought about that day a lot—especially as we pass the nine year anniversary of a minority of Senators filibustering a background checks bill.
I think about the parents who gave us a magnet with a photo of their child that we attached to the microwave of our Tucson home. I think about the educator who survived the attack and was released from the hospital right before coming to our meeting.
And every time I hear of another school shooting, I am brought back to that day. All of us are, no doubt.
The news doesn’t cover the issue of gun violence on a daily basis, but Congress should never forget the shame it brought upon itself when they looked at the most benign and practical of solutions to reduce gun violence, offered by moderates from each party... and chose to do nothing.
But please know that while this issue isn’t always top-of-mind, it is something I am working on every day.
I will NEVER give up until we have done all we can to make our communities safer from gun violence. But I cannot do that alone. I need your help.
So please:

body:
I got into this race to work FOR YOU. Not for greedy corporations. | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44721286/342818893/1820125544?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83ODQ0NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNDNiNDUwMC1lYmM3LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XEGHKdZxvLIMzH1LJas7_yCQWd7Kw7C2JZkHBAfw12M=) Hey friend, I know getting so many emails from candidates like me can feel overwhelming (I receive them too, trust me, I get it). But I wanted to let you know **_why_** we send these messages -- especially now. You’ve heard me say before that I’m not taking any money from corporate PACs or special interest groups. But my opponent, Ryan Zinke, is. Those organizations donate to candidates like Zinke because they know he’ll work for them if he’s elected to Congress. [****(But if you'd like to go ahead and make a donation, here's a link!)****](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44721405/342819354/805649176?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk783-fr-nd-v1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MzU5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmY2U2MGQyNi1lYmM3LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=a2bG1rqJ4EtmGnoj7oF2muEfPIQI4_3_4FcqS-VVP8k=)

Wade and control women's health care decisions; a senator who defended Donald Trump's attempts to overturn the election and then stood on stage with him in Des Moines to accept his endorsement.
Sen. Grassley is wrong for Iowa, and his leadership has failed us. **With Abby in the Senate, working families would have a true champion in Washington. It's what they need; it's what they deserve; and, come November, it's what they're going to choose.**

Women across the country are under attack from the GOP - we can't back down.
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44721879/342821486/396464211?refcode=em-logo&refcode2=658a613e-eec7-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&contactdata=Dm2UrRivoDwiyF1S4tjkEmZ7gVyzIOMJSN4nyw9RSfm%2BJgxYIzf%2FdOlcsM3JOYbz&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODIzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NThhNjEzZS1lZWM3LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hn7nke2kCU1OSFZflwXEKVldQX9yeFCCVp_nohsZ3zo=)
For far too long, folks who call themselves ‘conservatives’ have been waging a war on women’s health and reproductive freedom — and using this as an issue to divide us in this country.
Republican leaders from many of the same states that wanted to secede from the union over the government’s ‘mask mandate’ are just fine legislating women’s health care decisions for them.
And let’s be clear, the GOP attack goes beyond restricting access to legal abortion services — it is a broader attack on women’s reproductive health services. Just yesterday Senate Democrats had to push back against Republican efforts to deny patients access to essential and affordable care through the Title X gag rule — including access to birth control, cancer screenings, STI testing, and more.
We need to make it crystal clear that we are united and determined to protect reproductive freedom as the law of the land.
[**Will you join me? Add your name to send a clear message that we will not back down on the fight to protect access to women’s health care and reproductive freedom in our country.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44721880/342821487/-1856071576?refcode=em220429wrpet&refcode2=658a613e-eec7-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&contactdata=Dm2UrRivoDwiyF1S4tjkEmZ7gVyzIOMJSN4nyw9RSfm%2BJgxYIzf%2FdOlcsM3JOYbz&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODIzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NThhNjEzZS1lZWM3LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hn7nke2kCU1OSFZflwXEKVldQX9yeFCCVp_nohsZ3zo=&emci=4f874e34-ccc7-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=658a613e-eec7-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=2216363)
**[Add your name](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44721881/342821488/-1856071576?refcode=em220429wrpet&refcode2=658a613e-eec7-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&contactdata=Dm2UrRivoDwiyF1S4tjkEmZ7gVyzIOMJSN4nyw9RSfm%2BJgxYIzf%2FdOlcsM3JOYbz&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODIzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NThhNjEzZS1lZWM3LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hn7nke2kCU1OSFZflwXEKVldQX9yeFCCVp_nohsZ3zo=&emci=4f874e34-ccc7-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=658a613e-eec7-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=2216363)**
My very first campaign was on the ‘Choice Team’ that defeated a state legislator opposed to reproductive freedom. I won that election and worked to pass the bill that successfully codified _Roe v. Wade_ in Maryland law.
From that time to today, I have worked to defend reproductive freedom and I'm proud to have been recognized by NARAL Pro-Choice America, National Organization for Women Political Action Committee (NOW PAC), and the Planned Parenthood Action Fund for my work.
But today Republican state legislatures across the country are declaring war on women’s health services and if we lose control of the Senate and our ability to pass national legislation to protect them, poor women in these states will lose access not just to safe and legal abortion services, but affordable birth control, cancer screenings, and more.
That's why it's more important than ever that we don’t stop working and organizing to defeat those extremists who in the name of “ending abortion in America” (‘legal’ abortion services) are waging a full-throated war against publicly funded women’s health services.
[**Will you add your name today and join me in the fight against the GOP attack on reproductive freedom?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44721882/342821489/-1856071576?refcode=em220429wrpet&refcode2=658a613e-eec7-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&contactdata=Dm2UrRivoDwiyF1S4tjkEmZ7gVyzIOMJSN4nyw9RSfm%2BJgxYIzf%2FdOlcsM3JOYbz&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODIzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NThhNjEzZS1lZWM3LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hn7nke2kCU1OSFZflwXEKVldQX9yeFCCVp_nohsZ3zo=&emci=4f874e34-ccc7-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=658a613e-eec7-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=2216363)
Thank you for speaking out. Whatever the obstacles, we must stand together and fight on to defeat those who want to take this country backwards.
Onwards,
Chris

name: Geoff Diehl
subject: Reminder: Maura Healey wants to 'revisit' TCI. I won't let that happen.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Diehl for Massachusetts PO Box 60362 Worcester, MA 01606
body:
| | | |
---
| Did you see the latest news?
Maura Healey reportedly told a gubernatorial forum last night that she would "revisit" the Transportation and Climate Initiative (TCI) if she is elected Governor.
Not that I'm at all surprised... Healey has made her progressive agenda focused on climate change more and more obvious recently, making it the focal point of her campaign.
---
|
---
|
---
---
| But it is still very alarming that Maura Healey, as a candidate for Governor, is signaling her intention to give up our state's sovereignty and sock taxpayers with enormous tax increases in future years by rejoining TCI.
Together, we scored an enormous victory last year when Governor Baker abandoned his efforts to have Massachusetts join TCI. We can't afford to go back to the beginning again.
It's clear that the only way to defeat these policies is to have strong, conservative leadership in the Governor's Office.
I am the only candidate in this race who is capable of delivering this leadership. I am the only person who is ready to stand up to Maura Healey and progressive, far-left policies on Beacon Hill. You've seen me do it before with the gas tax. You've seen me do it before with the Democrats' plan to bring the Olympics to our state. I'm ready to do it again, as much as necessary, to protect you and our state.
Can I depend on you for your support?

| | Team,

We’re still waiting for Kean Jr.’s response to the GOP referring to January 6, 2021, as “legitimate political discourse” – and we have a feeling we’ll be waiting a long time!

_**"I make a hard distinction between Black conservatives and these tokens [Herschel Walker and Senator Tim Scott], who are out here right now, shucking and jiving for their white handlers."**
--Eli Mystal, MSNBC_

Fellow American,

I recently wrote to you about a racist article attacking me in _The Nation_.

The author had some pretty heinous things to say because I'm a Black conservative. You may recall this line:

_"Herschel Walker's candidacy is a white insult to Black people."_
Well, Fellow American, he's back at it again. MSNBC featured this man on their network this week so he could spew even more anti-Black, anti-conservative vitriol in the name of mediocre TV ratings.

He doubled down in his attacks on me. This time he attacked Republican Senator Tim Scott (SC) too. Here's part of what he said:

_"I make a hard distinction between Black conservatives and these tokens [referring to me and Senator Tim Scott], who are out here right now, shucking and jiving for their white handlers."_
**That's racist, disgusting, and sad.**

I never wanted the color of my skin to be a focal point of this Senate campaign, but these attacks on my character and my skin color have gone too far.

**You can help me prove them wrong by standing with me at this critical moment.**

---

| | Hi folks,

As you know by now, I am running for re-election in California’s newly-drawn 18th district. This includes my home in San Jose and some areas that I have represented in Congress and local office for a number of years — but it is also nearly half new territory for me. I am now running where many voters are not familiar with me or my record and my work in Congress — and they have never seen my name on a ballot.

This is a very different re-election effort for me. This time, I have to use the resources I raise from friends and supporters to run my own campaign — to hold meet and greet opportunities, get out my message, organize voters, and fund a GOTV program. As you can imagine, all of this gets quite expensive.

And it is so important that we reach every deadline benchmark to have what we need to win.

[1]Justice Democrats

Peter, our average
contribution in April is $17.70.

contribution $17.70

Here’s why we’re proud of that number: We don’t accept corporate dollars,
and instead rely on our grassroots supporters to give what they can and
fuel our organizing and electoral efforts.

Unlike the political establishment, we don’t believe in alarmist
fundraising tactics. We’ll never scam our supporters out of a dollar and
have built this movement through mutual respect and the desire to change
the status quo.

We still have fundraising benchmarks to reach in order to execute the
campaigns and advocacy efforts needed to hold Democrats accountable and
transform the Democratic party. [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/104661?refcode=em20220429-23098&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=23098%2E1203867%2ER7vSKo ]We need at least 500 people to give
$17.70 or whatever they can, in order to meet our end-of-month fundraising
goal. Can you be the next person to help us reach our goal?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/104661?refcode=em20220429-23098&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1022&akid=23098%2E1203867%2ER7vSKo ]Contribute

In just a few years, the candidates we’ve elected to Congress, like AOC,
Ilhan, Jamaal, Cori, have made a tremendous impact, while do-nothing
incumbents have just done little except raise more corporate PAC money for
their re-election and maintain the status quo.

The establishment has proven that even with the majority, they won’t fight
for our values. If we want to cancel student loan debt, pass Medicare for
All, and win a Green New Deal, we’re going to have to elect more
progressives to Congress.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/104661?refcode=em20220429-23098&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1023&akid=23098%2E1203867%2ER7vSKo ]So if you’re able to, can you please chip in and help us meet our
fundraising goals? Not everyone who reads this will donate, but even just
a couple of dollars makes a difference.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/104661?refcode=em20220429-23098&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1024&akid=23098%2E1203867%2ER7vSKo ]Contribute

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/28883?t=1025&akid=23098%2E1203867%2ER7vSKo ]here. We appreciate everything you do to keep our movement strong.

Please stay informed and follow the most up-to-date recommendations from the
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/24438?t=1026&akid=23098%2E1203867%2ER7vSKo ]Centers for Disease Control and your state public health department.

subject: Your 2022 Second Amendment Survey
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vskkzx0H_N

The far Left in America is attempting to rewrite our nation's
history and undermine our Constitution-with a special emphasis on
eliminating the Second Amendment. Today, you're receiving
Hillsdale College's Second Amendment Survey because you're
someone who understands that education is essential to the
defense of liberty.
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oskkzx0H_N

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear Friend of the Constitution,

The far Left in America is attempting to
rewrite our nation's history and undermine our Constitution-with
a special emphasis on eliminating the Second Amendment.

Today, you're receiving Hillsdale College's
Second Amendment Survey because you're someone who understands
that education is essential to the defense of liberty.

We are reaching and teaching millions of
Americans about the importance of liberty, and we are doing this
without accepting even ONE PENNY of government funding.

Could you take a few minutes to complete our
Second Amendment Survey using the secure link below?

https://lp.hillsdale.edu/2a-survey/

Your timely survey answers will help us reach
and teach millions of our fellow citizens in the coming year
about the importance of liberty-which includes the rights
protected by the Second Amendment.

There is no question that one of the Left's
most powerful tools in its ongoing effort to undermine our
liberty is ignorance.

Here at Hillsdale, we have been pursuing
truth and defending liberty since the College was founded in
1844.

Today our educational outreach efforts
include programs on a variety of topics essential to liberty,
such as the Second Amendment.

As constitutional scholar Edward J. Erler
observed in Imprimis, our digest of liberty that reaches millions
of Americans: "The Second Amendment is an expression of first
principles."

This means the Second Amendment is essential
for the preservation of freedom. If we are denied the means of
defending our freedom, we will eventually lose our freedom.

This kind of thinking is foreign to most
college and university campuses today, where "safe spaces" are
now commonplace, and shooting clubs are nearly extinct. Here's an
example…

Not long ago, the University of Virginia
canceled its traditional 21-gun salute on Veterans Day.

Why?

The administration was concerned that firing
guns in honor of those who served their country and did their
part to defend our freedom would cause "panic" among the student
body.

Unfortunately, there are many more such
examples I could cite to illustrate the disastrous effects of the
ongoing decline in civics education in America.

But instead of just TALKING, it's more
important to DO something about it.

That's why we have been working to expand our
educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.

And this work continues today.

That's why I would like your answers to our
brief Second Amendment Survey. You can complete the survey today
at this secure link:

https://lp.hillsdale.edu/2a-survey/

We believe that an educated citizenry is
essential for the preservation of our liberty. As Ronald Reagan
said, "Freedom is never more than one generation away from
extinction."

Do you agree? I hope so.

This is why we reach and teach millions of
Americans about the principles of liberty and the Constitution.
It's also why we need your help today.

As I mentioned, Hillsdale refuses to accept
ONE PENNY of government funding-not even indirectly in the form
of federal or state student grants or loans. This frees us from
much burdensome and corrupting federal regulation.

Our independence from the government means
that our work is entirely dependent on the generous support of
citizens like you, who understand the importance of education to
liberty.

It also means your gift really matters.

Today, you have a great opportunity to help
preserve liberty-including the Second Amendment-for future
generations.

After completing your Second Amendment
Survey, please join me in the cause of liberty with your generous
tax-deductible gift today.

And, when you give a $100 gift or more, we'll
send you a special, limited-edition Hillsdale College hat as our
thank you.

This hat commemorates our partnership with
USA Shooting, the organization dedicated to preparing the best
American shooters to represent our country in the Olympics and
Paralympics. But hurry-supplies are limited!

Thank you for your time and attention. I look
forward to receiving your completed Second Amendment Survey.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since
1844

P.S. Our Constitution-including the Second
Amendment-is under attack today. Do you agree? Then please take
our Second Amendment Survey at the secure link below. It will
only take a few minutes, and your answers will help to preserve
liberty for future generations. Thank you!

https://lp.hillsdale.edu/2a-survey/
